paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of data entries across different task categories. The dataset primarily consists of Math (29.3%), Coding (24.3%), and Information Seeking (22.2%) tasks, followed by Reasoning (10.4%), Planning (2.3%), Creative Writing (2.2%), and other combined categories (9.3%).
model_annotation: The pie chart shows the distribution of dataset entries across task categories, presented as proportions of the total. It contains 7 slices: Math, shown in a light pink/salmon color at approximately 29.3%; Coding, in medium blue at approximately 24.3%; Information Seeking, in light green at approximately 22.2%; Reasoning, in a pale orange/peach color at approximately 10.4%; Planning, in a light lavender/purple color at approximately 2.3%; Creative Writing, in light pink/magenta at approximately 2.2%; and Others (combined), in a very light green/mint color at approximately 9.3%. Percentage labels are displayed next to the corresponding slices around the outside of the pie, and a legend titled “Categories” appears in the upper-left listing each category with its associated color and a count in parentheses. No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slices are arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering rule.
